panels.title: Total Session Duration (Hours)
panels.sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(count() * 6 / 3600.0, 2) as total_playtime_hours
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND reqPath LIKE '%.ts'
  AND reqPath NOT LIKE '%.m3u8'
  AND statusCode IN (200, 206)
  AND extract(reqPath, '[-_](\\d+)\\.ts$') != ''
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total Session Duration (Hours); du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Total Users ( Based on Device ID - APP DATA) - Per Minute
panels.sql:
SELECT 
uniq(device_id) as uniq_users, 
$__timeInterval(toStartOfMinute(reqTimeSec)) as time
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY time

panels.title: Playtime by GEO
panels.sql:
SELECT 
    decodeURLComponent(country) as country,
    decodeURLComponent(state) as state,
   decodeURLComponent(city) as city,
  count() * 6 / 60.0 as playtime_hours
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND reqPath LIKE '%.ts'
  AND statusCode IN (200, 206)
  AND state!= ''
  AND extract(reqPath, '[-_](\\d+)\\.ts$') != ''
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY  state,country,city
ORDER BY playtime_hours DESC
  SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Playtime by Geography; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Unique Client IP by Geo
panels.sql:
SELECT 
    decodeURLComponent(country) as country,
    decodeURLComponent(state) as state,
     decodeURLComponent(city) as city,
    uniqExact(cliIP) AS unique_cliIP
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY country, state,city
ORDER BY unique_cliIP DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Playtime by Geography; du=${__user.login}'
